newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Explorers Index lifts again in week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Explorers Index lifts again in week.

text.p: Stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index rose 43.6 points or 1.48 percent last week. The All Ordinaries index rose 1.07 percent.
Nov 15 Nov 8 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorer Index rose again last week, the index adding 43.6 points as speculative resource stocks although mixed, continued to attract plenty of buying interest.
The number of stocks in the index falling just outnumbered those rising.

Among the stronger issues was nickel hopeful, Capricorn Resources Australia NL, which jumped four cents to 14.5 cents after it announced a good nickel intersection at its 25 percent owned Roundtop project in Western Australia.
Money Mining NL rose three cents to 25.5 cents as it continued to report encouraging results from its Granny Venn prospect near Menzies in Western Australia.

Helix Resources NL moved eight cents higher to 45 cents on investor interest in the company's exploration in the Gawler Craton region of South Australia while Comet Gold NL lifted three cents to 24 cents as it began to drill its newly acquired Ravensthorpe nickel prospect in Western Australia.
Other strong performances included Finders Gold NL which rose 2.1 cents to 9.3 cents and Kingstream Resources NL, up 10 cents to 63 cents.

Weaker isues over the week included Sovereign Resources (Australia) NL, off 1.1 cents to 8.9 cents, Walhalla Mining Co NL, down six cents to 42 cents and Terrex Resources NL down 0.9 cents to 4.4 cents.
